mom_settings.intro:
Individual Test — Cumulative (Weeks 1–13)

This is an individual graded test covering material from the entire semester through Week 13. Work alone — no group collaboration.

Topics covered:

  • Ch1 (Weeks 1–2) — Functions and Linear Models (§1.1–1.7): function notation, domain, average rate of change; linear modeling word problems
  • Ch2 (Weeks 3–4) — Systems and Matrices (§2.2): 3×3 system via row reduction (RREF)
  • Ch3 (Weeks 5–6) — Linear Programming Graphical (§3.3, §3.5): corner-point evaluation and LP formulation
  • Ch4 (Week 7) — Simplex Method (§4.1–4.2): 2-variable simplex maximization
  • Ch6 (Weeks 9–10) — Finance (§6.1, §6.4): compound interest end-to-end; loan payment and total cost of borrowing
  • Ch7 (Weeks 11–12) — Sets and Counting (§7.1–7.2, §7.5): 2-circle Venn inclusion-exclusion; combinations word problem
  • Ch8 (Week 13) — Probability (§8.4): conditional probability from a 2-way table (P(A|B) vs P(B|A) asymmetry)

Rules:

  • 3 attempts per question, but a 33% reduction kicks in on any attempt after you have earned a full-score attempt — your first full-score lock is your strongest score.
  • Solutions revealed only after your last attempt (or when the date window closes).
  • 10 questions × 10 points = 100 points total.
  • Work alone. No group collaboration; this is the individual version of the W1–13 material.

planning_notes.selection_priority: Even coverage across W1–13 spanning Ch1, Ch2, Ch3, Ch4, Ch6, Ch7, Ch8. All 10 slots are high-impact full multipart questions exercising multiple parts of each process. 5 reuse from group tests (Group Final Quiz 1 + Group Final Quiz 2) so students see familiar scenarios; 5 new drafts for novelty (function comprehensive, LP graphical comprehensive, compound interest comprehensive, Venn inclusion-exclusion, combinations sports team). No FRQs.
